headings.usage: Use for massive, high-impact titles, hero text, and project names. MUST use uppercase and tracking-wider for that aggressive streetwear/creator vibe. NO generic fonts like Inter.

body.usage: Use for UI labels, transcript text, settings, and standard paragraph text. Clean, geometric, highly legible.

mono.usage: Use for timestamp displays, API key inputs, and technical progress statuses.

surfaces: Grid Borders: Use strict 1px border-white/10 on panels to create a technical, 'editing bay' skeleton. No soft shadows. No transparent backgrounds over content.
Tracing Beam: Apply a neon gradient border to the active playing transcript segment or processing card to make it look alive.
Glassmorphism: Strictly reserved for floating overlays (like B-roll pickers or settings modal). Use backdrop-blur-2xl bg-black/60 with a 1px border-white/20.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a very subtle SVG noise/grain overlay (opacity 2-5%) over the entire app background to kill digital flatness and give it a raw 'music video' feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: Sharp edges everywhere. Use rounded-none or max rounded-sm. Absolutely no pill-shaped buttons unless it's a specific 'TikTok' style toggle.

component_guidelines.buttons: Brutalist. Solid #CCFF00 with black text for primary. Hover state: Translate X and Y by -2px with a hard #CCFF00 drop shadow (box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px #CCFF00).
component_guidelines.transcription_editor: The core tool. Text should be large (text-xl to text-2xl). 'Ums' and 'uhs' highlighted in destructive red or strikethrough. Active playing word gets a 'karaoke' glow.
component_guidelines.b_roll_cards: Bento-style grid. When hovering over a suggested B-roll clip, use a slight scale transform and play a preview if available.
component_guidelines.progress_indicators: Kinetic typography or ASCII art loaders. Example: massive outline text running in the background while video renders.
component_guidelines.forms_and_inputs: For API keys: pure brutalist inputs. bg-transparent, border-b-2 border-white/20, focus:border-brand. Monospace text.
component_guidelines.toggles: Physical-looking switches. When toggling between 'TikTok Aggressive' and 'YouTube Clean', the whole UI accent color could shift slightly (Pink/Cyan vs Solid Red).

grids_and_layouts.app_layout: Fullscreen dashboard layout. Left/Right sidebars (w-64 to w-80) for tools and project lists, fixed height. Center pane is the video preview and transcription timeline.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8 for panels. The bento grid for b-roll should use gap-6 or gap-8.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Strict left alignment for settings and text. Center the video preview perfectly. Use bento grids for dashboard.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Hard, aggressive transitions. Instead of soft fades, use snappy spring animations in framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Wipe effects or stark color flashes to mimic video cuts.
motion_and_interactions.transcription_sync: Smooth automatic scrolling of the transcription box as the video plays. The active word should scale up slightly (1.1x) and turn #CCFF00.

accessibility.contrast: Text over backgrounds must meet APCA standards. Brand neon (#CCFF00) against black is excellent. Black text on brand neon is also excellent.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#CCFF00] focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-black.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

media_and_3d.images: Use high-energy, raw, streetwear, or cyberpunk aesthetic images for placeholders.
media_and_3d.icons: Use iconoir-react or lucide-react. Bold, technical strokes. No emoji.
media_and_3d.3d_libraries: If rendering an 'AI Processing' state, consider a lightweight particle canvas or kinetic marquee text to simulate intense computational effort.

image_urls.description: man in midair skateboarding (Good for aggressive TikTok style demo)
futuristic city at night with neon lights (Good for B-roll preview)

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a Gen-Z, unhinged, high-energy SaaS video editor.
Do NOT make it look like a standard corporate dashboard. Use the provided Anton and Outfit fonts.
Default to a strict dark mode using #050505 as the base background.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the main layout to allow brutalist, sharp edges. DO NOT use generic rounded cards.
Shadcn UI can be used for complex components (Dialogs, Select) but MUST be customized to remove rounded corners and soft shadows.
Implement the transcription area as a scrollable timeline with 'karaoke' active word highlighting.
Include a 'Style Picker' that drastically changes the caption preview visualization (TikTok vs YouTube).
Never use generic placeholders. Use real Pixabay or personal-library assets for B-roll previews.
Build a custom settings modal for Groq, Cerebras, and Pixabay API keys.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals over content.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Use solid blocks of high-contrast colors.
Use modern, sharp, brutalist interactions. NEVER use pill-shaped unless explicitly a toggle.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons. Use real SVG icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
